Token Usage

Display token consumption with progress bars, cost estimates, warnings, and model information.

Basic Token Display

Simple token count with icon.

Used 1,247 / 4,096 tokens
Used 3,892 / 4,096 tokens
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-token">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
    <span>Used <span class="zak-ai-token-value">1,247</span> / 4,096 tokens</span>
</div>

Progress Bar

Visual progress bar showing token consumption levels.

Token usage1,247 / 4,096
Token usage3,200 / 4,096
Token usage3,980 / 4,096
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-token-bar">
    <div class="zak-ai-token-bar-header">
        <span>Token usage</span>
        <span>1,247 / 4,096</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-ai-token-bar-track">
        <div class="zak-ai-token-bar-fill normal" style="width:30%"></div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Fill classes: normal, warning, danger -->

With Cost Estimate

Token usage paired with estimated cost.

1,247 tokens $0.025
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-token-cost">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
    <span class="zak-ai-token-cost-label">1,247 tokens</span>
    <span class="zak-ai-token-cost-value">$0.025</span>
</div>

Warnings

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-token                 /* Basic token display */
.zak-ai-token-value           /* Bold token number */
.zak-ai-token-bar             /* Bar with header + track */
.zak-ai-token-bar-header      /* Label + count row */
.zak-ai-token-bar-track       /* Progress bar background */
.zak-ai-token-bar-fill        /* Progress bar fill */
.zak-ai-token-bar-fill.normal /* Purple (0-70%) */
.zak-ai-token-bar-fill.warning/* Orange (70-90%) */
.zak-ai-token-bar-fill.danger /* Red (90%+) */
.zak-ai-token-cost            /* Cost estimate container */
.zak-ai-token-cost-label      /* Token count text */
.zak-ai-token-cost-value      /* Price text */
.zak-ai-token-warning         /* Warning banner */
.zak-ai-token-warning.near-limit/* Approaching limit */
.zak-ai-token-warning.exceeded /* Limit exceeded */
.zak-ai-token-compact         /* Inline compact display */
.zak-ai-token-model           /* Model card container */
.zak-ai-token-model-avatar    /* Model icon */
.zak-ai-token-model-info      /* Model name + detail */
.zak-ai-token-model-name      /* Model name */
.zak-ai-token-model-detail    /* Context window text */
.zak-ai-token-model-count     /* Token count number */
